summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and spot prices were broadly under pressure today. DCE most-traded closed at 684.0 yuan/mt, down 0.51% from the previousclose, and all eight major Qingdao port quotations declined. The 61%, 58% and 65% port indices fell 3, 1 and 4 yuan, respectively.
